violation_type.title: Install CO Detector System- In Compliance with State or Local Fire Marshal's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5535(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Install CO Detector System- In Compliance with State or Local Fire Marshal's Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: There was not a working carbon monoxide detector present during the operation.   A staff member installed batteries in the carbon monoxide detector during my visit.

finding_variants.text: There was not a working carbon monoxide detector present during the operation.   A staff member installed batteries in the carbon monoxide detector during my visit.
The carbon monoxide detector was not installed during my operation.   It was found and plugged in during my visit.
